segments.he: נִשְׁבֵּית חַיָּיב לִפְדּוֹתָהּ וְכוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: נִשְׁבֵּית בְּחַיֵּי בַּעְלָהּ, וְאַחַר כָּךְ מֵת בַּעְלָהּ. הִכִּיר בָּהּ בַּעֲלָהּ — יוֹרְשִׁין חַיָּיבִין לִפְדּוֹתָהּ. לֹא הִכִּיר בָּהּ בַּעֲלָהּ — אֵין יוֹרְשִׁין חַיָּיבִין לִפְדּוֹתָהּ.
segments.en: § The mishna taught that if «she was taken captive,» her husband «is obligated to redeem her. The Sages taught» in a baraita: In the case of a wife who was «taken captive in her husband’s lifetime and afterward her husband died» before he could redeem her, if «her husband was aware of her» captivity, the «heirs are obligated to redeem her,» but «if her husband was not aware of her» captivity, his «heirs are not obligated to redeem her.»

moves.about: mishna lemma: if she was captured he must redeem her

moves.summary: Baraita: heirs redeem only if the husband knew
moves.about: heirs' obligation to redeem a widow captured during her husband's lifetime depends on his knowing
